## Client zero

Locked: v2.2 on 13 Sep 2026. Proposed: v2.3, which carries:

- The Week 1 Friday lab dataset, version v3-lab (tracker, Week 1 Friday row, 21 September).
- The Week 16 client card (19 September).
- The scenario facts, dataset versions and sub-problem seeds of Weeks 10 to 15 (21 September).
- The re-date of 21 September, which moves every date in the v2.2 ladder by one week and moves tokenization to the Week 7 Friday.

Still open inside it: a name for the Kalpa Logistics stakeholder; the finance controller's limits and ceilings; the Week 16 call volumes.

Addendum to v2.2, locked on 28 Sep 2026 by the requester: Kalpa's Bengaluru engineering and data centre is Kalpa's Global Capability Centre, the cohort are trainee engineers in its data and AI team, and every pack carries three recurring beats: the client's ask, Kavya Nair's review and the interview question. It adds a name and a framing to v2.2 and invalidates nothing.

Addendum to v2.2, locked on 30 Sep 2026 by the requester: Kalpa Health serves the US market: a diagnostics and revenue-cycle business whose laboratories and patient service centres test US patients and bill US payers, with its analytics and revenue-cycle work run from Kalpa's GCC in Bengaluru, the way the Indian centres of US health systems, laboratories and revenue-cycle firms work. Dr Priya Menon stays its COO and Build 1 keeps its growth question and its five sub-problems, now in dollars across US metro areas, with the payer, the claim, the denial and prior authorisation in the room's vocabulary. Every Kalpa Health record is synthetic, so no protected health information exists in the repository. The Build 1 generator and the Week 3 packs are revised to it; until then they carry the India setting of v2.2.

Addendum to v2.2, locked on 01 Oct 2026 by the requester: Week 1 Thursday's exposure table is the campaign platform's August list: the 160 customers the platform reports on for the monsoon sale, 60 of them marked exposed, under the platform's own customer ids, C-6000 to C-6159. Finance's order file keys its customers C-2000 to C-5003, so no row of the list matches an order and the two are separate populations. The campaigns table is the plan, which aims the sale at Retail-Plus; the list records who received it, whatever the plan aimed at, so it marks 30 Retail-Core customers exposed beside 30 Retail-Plus. The addendum gives the Week 1 Thursday list an origin and changes no number in v2.2 or in that day's data.
